title: tests/kernel/Makefile: build all kernel test modules
description: Makefile for tests/kernel/ that builds all seven test modules (test_skcipher.ko, test_aead.ko, test_shash.ko, test_akcipher.ko, test_kpp.ko, test_rng.ko, test_fips_gate.ko) as separate kernel modules. Each test module has KBUILD_EXTRA_SYMBOLS pointing to both wolfSSL's Module.symvers and wolfkm's Module.symvers. Supports the same WOLFCRYPT_DIR, KBUILD_EXTRA_SYMBOLS, and CC variables as the top-level Makefile.
design: Each test_*.c becomes a separate obj-m entry. All test modules must compile in stub mode (WOLFKM_HAVE_WOLFCRYPT=0) for CI builds without wolfCrypt. Use subdir-m or explicit obj-m list. The Makefile must work when called from run_kernel_tests.sh with absolute paths.
acceptance_criteria: make -C /lib/modules/$(uname -r)/build M=$(pwd) from tests/kernel/ builds all seven .ko files with zero warnings.
